title: EP-Governance Authorization Token
description: Schema for an authorization token issued by the EP-Governance lattice to authorize a transition for execution.

authorization_id.description: Unique 20-char lowercase base32hex identifier for this authorization token.

transition_id.description: XID of the transition this authorization token authorizes.

agent_id.description: XID of the agent this authorization is issued to.

project_id.description: XID of the project this authorization is scoped to.

branch_id.description: XID of the branch this authorization is scoped to.

proxy_audience.description: The audience (e.g., proxy or executor) this token is intended for.

tool.description: Name of the tool this authorization permits.

payload_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the authorized payload, prefixed with 'sha256:'.

policy_set_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the policy set that was evaluated, prefixed with 'sha256:'.

matched_policy_versions.description: Object mapping matched policy XIDs to their version integers.

issued_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this authorization token was issued.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this authorization token expires.

nonce.description: Unique nonce to prevent token replay.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the token contents, prefixed with 'ed25519:'.
